tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Content area behind tables and forms. Warm-neutral, never pure white. shadcn: --background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons. Ink, never pure black. shadcn: --foreground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: tables, panels, inputs, the search field. shadcn: --card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. shadcn: --card-foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, the command palette, the tenant switcher, dialogs, bottom sheets. shadcn: --popover.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover. shadcn: --popover-foreground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: table header row, skeletons, disabled inputs, code. shadcn: --muted.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: emails under names, timestamps, hints. 5.9:1 on background (light), 7.4:1 (dark). shadcn: --muted-foreground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hovered row and hovered menu item. Not a brand colour. shadcn: --accent.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent. shadcn: --accent-foreground.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill. shadcn: --secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. shadcn: --secondary-foreground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deep cobalt. The action colour: the primary button, links, the selected rail icon, the selected tab underline, the logo tile. 7:1 with primary-foreground (light), 5.9:1 (dark). shadcn: --primary.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. shadcn: --primary-foreground.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rail item, selected tenant in the switcher, selected table row.

tokens.name: primary-subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Icon and text on primary-subtle.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, card edges, the rail edge. Decorative only. shadcn: --border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes. 3:1 against card in both themes. shadcn: --input.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px with 2px offset. Never removed. shadcn: --ring.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Red: act now. Destructive buttons (Remove member, Close tenant) and the dot of critical states. shadcn: --destructive.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Critical status label, inline field errors.

tokens.name: destructive-subtle
tokens.usage: Error banner background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green: normal and working. Status dot only.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Status label next to a success dot: Active.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success banner background, for example after a tenant is reactivated.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber: caution, follow up. Status dot only.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Status label next to a warning dot: Suspended.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning banner background, for example on a suspended tenant.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Cyan: in progress, waiting on someone. Status dot only.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Status label next to an info dot: Invited, Provisioning.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Grey: ended, no action needed. Status dot only.

tokens.name: neutral-text
tokens.usage: Status label next to a neutral dot: Closed, Expired, Revoked.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Navigation rail and phone drawer. shadcn: --sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Unselected rail icons and labels. shadcn: --sidebar-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Current rail item background. shadcn: --sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Current rail item icon. shadcn: --sidebar-accent-foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Rail edge. shadcn: --sidebar-border.

tokens.name: platform
tokens.usage: Platform app only: the Platform label beside the logo. Ink, not a hue, so no status meaning is borrowed.

tokens.name: platform-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on platform.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, drawers and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Table and list row under the pointer.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a meter or progress bar.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip surface. Inverted from the page.

tokens.name: tooltip-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tooltip.

tokens.name: tooltip-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on tooltip, such as a shortcut.

tokens.name: env-staging
tokens.usage: The Staging strip at the top of the window, and the staging tab icon. Not shown in Production.

tokens.name: env-staging-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon on env-staging.

tokens.name: role-owner-subtle
tokens.usage: Kept from the design for the Owner pill tone. No screen uses it today.

tokens.name: role-owner-text
tokens.usage: Text on role-owner-subtle.

tokens.name: brand-gradient-end
tokens.usage: End colour of the logo tile gradient; the start is primary.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, under the breadcrumb.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ayşe Yılmaz invited İbrahim to Northwind Traders.
styles.usage: Default text on every screen. One density.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in tables, nav labels, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Emails under names, freshness lines, helper text, column headers. The smallest size in the product.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside small text: a name in a caption.

styles.name: page-title-ar
styles.usage: page-title in Arabic: same size, taller line, no negative tracking.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: دعا أحمد ali@northwind.io إلى الفريق قبل 2 ساعة.
styles.usage: body in Arabic. The email stays left-to-right; digits stay Western.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: UTC times, slugs, IDs, keyboard hints. Always left-to-right.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints in tooltips and the command menu.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot to label, icon to label in dense rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, compact cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Comfortable cell padding, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Content padding, page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap inside page headers.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, page gutter from tablet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty state vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tooltips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the search field, rail items, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tables, cards, popovers, the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only. No pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Selected rail item, the search field. Reads as an edge, not a lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, the tenant switcher, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the command palette, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Control height on desktop (fine pointer).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Control height on phone and on any coarse pointer below bp-tablet.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Control height on tablet: a coarse pointer from bp-tablet. 48px, not 44px, for gloves and use on the move.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch screens.

tokens.name: touch-target-tablet
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on tablet screens.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The sidebar as an icon rail, from bp-tablet to bp-desktop (the design's rail/width).

tokens.name: rail-expanded
tokens.usage: The sidebar open with its labels, from bp-desktop (the design's rail/expanded).

tokens.name: code-slot-width
tokens.usage: One box of the six-digit code on the sign-in and two-step boards.

tokens.name: code-slot-height
tokens.usage: One box of the six-digit code: taller than wide, for one digit at section-title size.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table and list row height.

tokens.name: row-header-height
tokens.usage: Table header row height.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area with a fine pointer (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8).

tokens.name: target-row-action
tokens.usage: Icon button inside a table row.

tokens.name: details-panel-width
tokens.usage: The details panel beside the content on desktop.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: the icon rail instead of the drawer, tables instead of card lists, centred dialogs (the design's breakpoint/tablet).

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here: the sidebar opens with its labels (the design's breakpoint/desktop).

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: From here: content stops at content-max.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header and page toolbar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Phone navigation drawer.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, the command palette.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and selects, also inside dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
